definitions.explanation: A structured game or play activity, especially those played by children or in educational settings. More formal than 遊び and often implies organized or rule-based activities. Composed of 遊 (play) + 戯 (frolic).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing a game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is playtime every day at kindergarten.

examples.japanese: {遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{楽|たの}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were having fun playing in the playroom.

notes:
USAGE:
{遊戯|ゆうぎ} is more formal and literary than ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧. It is commonly used in educational and institutional contexts (kindergartens, childcare facilities). Also well known from the manga and anime title {遊☆戯☆王|ゆうぎおう} (Yu-Gi-Oh!).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (playroom)
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (King of Games — the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise)
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (amusement facility)
- お{遊戯|ゆうぎ} (children's performance, play — polite form used in kindergartens)
